name: clouddev-ai-sovereign-workspace
description: Single-user browser IDE with Forgejo and OmniRoute for local use and Railway

scripts.test:cross-device: docker compose exec -T -e CLOUDDEV_CADDY_BIN=/usr/bin/caddy clouddev-ide node --test /opt/clouddev-ide/test/caddy-proxy.integration.test.mjs
scripts.check:compose: docker compose config --quiet && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.mock.yml --profile integration config --quiet
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:generate && uv run --project docs-site --locked mkdocs build --strict
scripts.docs:check: node --test tests/unit/docs-site.test.mjs tests/unit/docs-seo.test.mjs tests/unit/docs-screenshots.test.mjs && npm run docs:build && node scripts/check-docs-artifact.mjs .docs-site/site
